startup.summary: Run the package startup command on the target host and record only the bounded result.

health.summary: Run Web, API, and Engine health checks on the target host.

admin_login.summary: Initialize or use the first administrator account without recording credentials.

team_workspace.summary: Create reviewer/viewer accounts and verify workspace scope without recording personal data.

repository_import.summary: Import a permitted public or private repository and record only repo identity and bounded status.

review.summary: Open the review queue and record the bounded outcome.

why.summary: Run one grounded Why query and record status/citation count only.

drift.summary: Run Drift evaluation and record state/alert count only.

continuity.summary: Run the approved backup, restore, or recovery check and record the bounded result.

browser_smoke.summary: Open home, team, workspace, review, Why, Drift, and Evidence pages.

redaction_acknowledgement.note: Before archiving, remove tokens, .env values, private keys, raw logs, private source, and database backups.

limitations: This file is a template and is not customer-host proof until filled on the target host.
Do not paste secrets, raw logs, private source, .env values, or database backups into this file.
